comparator.name: Politiek, cultuur en religie
comparator.sourceNotes: Current formal evidence names the eight-course 60-EC foundation and Mohammed in the Present and Past (7.5 EC), and separately allocates 7.5 EC to an unpublished second disciplinary course, 7.5 EC to thesis preparation, 7.5 EC to the capstone, 30 EC to a selected depth package and 60 EC to genuine profiling. The corrected diagnostic records 172.5 EC of named or bounded supported components; it does not add the unpublished disciplinary course merely to force 180 EC. The selected Politics and Religion package remains at allocation level because current official sources conflict on its four-course membership. Programme instruction is Dutch plus English.

routeSelection.basis: The generic normalized target does not name a specialization. The current programme page presents Politics and Religion, Culture and Religion, and The Middle East as equally formal depth packages and does not designate one as broader or more representative. Politics and Religion is therefore retained as the first-listed neutral tie-break, independently of UCR fit; this route judgment does not resolve the missing curriculum components.
